title: Webcam-based Eye Gaze Tracking under Natural Head Movement
metricDefinition: Webcam eye-gaze estimation under natural head movement

extractionLocations.section: Abstract; Chapters 1, 5, and 6; participant and error discussions
extractionLocations.description: The study separates eye features from head movement and reports larger gaze-estimation errors during natural movement, supporting a construct boundary and measurement caution.
